question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The erroneous spelling is '**Secratariat**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Among the given Options the incorrectly spelt word is '**Secratariat**.' • Its correct spelling is '**Secretariat**'. • It means 'the department of a large international or political organization, especially the office of a Secretary-General, that manages the way the organization is run'. [सचिवालय; (किसी बड़े अंतरराष्‍ट्रीय या राजनीतिक संगठन विशेषतः महासचिव का कार्यालय, जिस पर संगठनों को संचालित करने का दायित्‍व होता है)] • *Example: The **secretariat** is under the charge of a government **secretary** who ranks next in precedence to the governor.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • The** remaining options are correctly spelt.** • **Tongue:** A muscular organ in the mouth, essential for tasting, swallowing, and articulating speech. • **Heartbeat: **The rhythmic expansion and contraction of the heart, pumping blood through the body. • **Performance:** The act of carrying out a task or displaying skill in an activity, often before an audience. 16c:Tc97, The correct answer is '**Judicious**'.
